items.title: NPC probing government data leaks
items.description: The National Privacy Commission is investigating reports of data leaks involving several government agencies.

items.title: Likhang Filipino Theatre in Pasay opens its doors
items.description: President Marcos and First Lady Liza Marcos on Friday inaugurated the 279-seat Likhang Filipino Theatre along Roxas Boulevard in Pasay, a new hub for artists to showcase their work and support the Philippines’ creative industry.

items.title: Groups back DFA on sustained talks with China
items.description: A total of 20 labor, business and civil society organizations expressed support for the call of the Department of Foreign Affairs to sustain dialogue and cooperation with China, citing its importance in advancing national interest and promoting economic growth.

items.title: PAGASA monitors ‘Cempaka’
items.description: A tropical storm outside the Philippine area of responsibility with international name Cempaka is being monitored by the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration.

items.title: Jonvic wants BJMP explanation on Romualdez aide
items.description: Officials from the New Quezon City Jail in Payatas are in hot water for allowing a personal staff of former speaker Martin Romualdez to stay with him around the clock in his cell.

items.title: Experts push passage of hospital nutrition care bill
items.description: Experts are pushing for the passage of a bill institutionalizing nutrition care in all public and private hospitals nationwide, saying standardized services could help identify nutritional risks early, improve patient recovery and reduce complications.

items.title: DND chief honors Philippines, US war veterans
items.description: Defense Secretary Gilbert Teodoro Jr. paid tribute to Filipino and American veterans yesterday for their sacrifices and service in defense of their respective countries, emphasizing the responsibility of present generations to preserve the freedoms and shared values they fought for.

items.title: DepEd to prioritize first-time recipients in MacBook rollout
items.description: The Department of Education will prioritize public school teachers who have never received a government- or school-issued laptop in the rollout of 231,725 newly procured devices, Education Secretary Sonny Angara vowed yesterday.

items.title: No Pax Silica announcement during ASEAN – US envoy
items.description: There are no plans for the signing of agreements on Pax Silica at the coming Association of Southeast Asian Nations Leaders’ Summit in Manila later this month contrary to media reports, US Ambassador Lee Lipton clarified yesterday.

items.title: Prosecution had its chance, but failed – VP Sara
items.description: The camp of Vice President Sara Duterte said the House prosecution team “had its chance but failed” in her Senate impeachment trial as the defense team takes its turn to present its evidence and witnesses beginning tomorrow.

items.title: UP outguns Ateneo in altercation-marred thriller to clinch Final Four anew
items.description: For the eighth straight UAAP season, the UP Fighting Maroons stay firmly in title contention after surviving a testy encounter with Katipunan rival Ateneo

items.title: Alex Eala survives Greek opponent, rain-hit Hong Kong semis for title berth
items.description: Filipina tennis superstar and world No. 17 Alex Eala keeps up her torrid surge through the 2026 Hong Kong Open, this time surviving Greek veteran Maria Sakkari in the semis to arrange a final match against Claire Liu

items.title: No Pax Silica deal at ASEAN Summit, says US envoy
items.description: Pax Silica decisions ‘will be made in full consultation’ with the Philippines, says US Ambassador Lee Lipton ahead of the ASEAN Summit in Manila

items.title: Taduran dangles last Filipino world boxing crown against Romero
items.description: ‘I won't let this title be taken away because I am the only world champion of the Philippines now,’ says Pedro Taduran, the pride of Libon, Albay who looks to defend his IBF minimumweight crown

items.title: Harvesting 30 years of music: Gloc-9 brings ‘Mga Ani’ to vinyl
items.description: Gloc-9 drops 11 of his most impactful songs in his first vinyl release, sharing some advice for young artists on mastering their craft

items.title: Bigger bank, broader base: TG Limcaoco’s BPI years
items.description: From overseeing a bank merger to scrapping transfer fees and bringing banking into neighborhood stores, it's been a busy five years for Limcaoco

items.title: The week in photos: October 31 to November 6, 2026
items.description: A recap of news, sports, lifestyle, entertainment, and human interest images from the Philippines and around the globe

items.title: FACT CHECK: SC didn’t rule Marcos’ budget signing unconstitutional
items.description: The Court faulted Congress for raising the President's proposed budget, and with the decision not yet final, no formal probe has been opened

items.title: Fresh off shock reelection, Brazil President Lula to join ASEAN Summit in Manila
items.description: Just weeks after a historic election triumph, Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva will head to the Philippines to join global leaders at the 49th ASEAN Summit

items.title: Eya Laure takes charge amid Choco Mucho’s PVL meltdowns
items.description: Choco Mucho star Eya Laure keeps a long-term outlook as the Flying Titans fall prey to a pair of huge collapses to kickstart their 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference title push
